jobs.location: Contract, REMOTE (UK), https://assume-ai.com We are a fast-growing AI startup. We help SMEs find where AI will produce a measurable return, then build the systems that deliver it: AI agents, Claude skills and production-grade business software, up to full business and enterprise systems. Stack: Claude Code, Vercel, Supabase. A good fit for software engineers moving into AI engineering: - Two weeks of paid AI training in our framework and methods before your first project. - Projects typically run over several months, and each one is substantial. - Large token limits for every contractor. You need to: read code in Python, JS/TS, SQL, HTML/CSS and Bash; design and build databases; use Git and GitHub confidently; and be professional and clear on client calls. The senior role also needs complete products or systems you have designed and shipped. Nice to have: Claude Code or similar AI tools, building Claude skills, embeddings and vector databases, Vercel/Supabase, project or account management. Process: introductory interview, short practical exercise, final interview. Starting as soon as possible. To apply email hugh@assume-ai.com with your CV
